newsitem.title: UK: British Polythene says plans to buy Wavin unit. [CORRECTED 14:16 GMT]
newsitem.headline: British Polythene says plans to buy Wavin unit. [CORRECTED 14:16 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear that British Polythene is buying a unit of Wavin and not the whole company.)

British Polythene Plc said on Monday it planned to buy an industrial films and sacks business, based in Belgium and the Netherlands, from Dutch Wavin BV, a 50 percent owned subsidiary of Royal Dutch/Shell.
British Polythene said the Wavin business had sales of 47 million stg last year, supplying markets in Germany, France and Britain.
Net assets and borrowings totalled 14 million stg at the end of last year and the company employed 340 people.
